name: comparators_v110
question: On the already unblinded GSE334503 and E-MTAB-9357 test donors, what donor-level standardized MAE do the published sciPENN and scLinear RNA-only predictors have, relative to the sealed CellBridge predictions?
reporting: Whatever the direction, one supplementary table. A main-text row is added only as a post hoc row. These tests do not reopen H1-H10 and are not Holm-adjusted.
donors: Fit on the sealed training donors only. Score the sealed test donors only. Calibration donors are not used.

inputs.GSE334503: Raw RNA counts and raw training ADT counts. Query protein is not read.
inputs.E-MTAB-9357: expm1 of the deposited log1p(CPM) RNA and of the training protein, the same count reconstruction totalVI received. Query protein is not read.

aggregation: Mean of the cell-level protein output within each donor-arm, then perturbed minus control. Predictions are not rescaled to the test truth. Standardized MAE uses the training-donor response SD of the sealed estimand, the same response_scale as the sealed tests. scLinear is trained on log1p protein, so its output is already on that scale. sciPENN z-scores proteins inside its published preprocessing and does not return those scale parameters, so its point prediction (AnnData.X) is averaged as returned.
inference: Paired sign-flip and paired donor bootstrap of (comparator loss minus CellBridge loss), same functions as the sealed sequence, seed behavior of those functions. Label post_hoc true. CellBridge RNA-only is the sealed cellbridge_rna_only vector, not a refit.

scipenn.constructor_and_train: Published defaults, including select_hvg, cell_normalize, log_normalize, gene_normalize, min_cells 30, min_genes 200, batch_size 128, quantiles, n_epochs 10000, ES_max 12, lr 0.001.
scipenn.use_gpu: Published default True. This machine has no CUDA, so the package falls back to CPU. That fallback is the package's own branch.
scipenn.weights: A new directory for each fit. The default load=True trains because that directory has no weight file.
scipenn.published_hvg: The package selects highly variable genes on the union of training and query RNA. Query protein is not part of that union. This is disclosed and not disabled.
scipenn.numba_pin: The wheel requires numba<=0.50.0. llvmlite 0.33 does not build on this arm64 Python 3.11 machine. sciPENN 0.9.6 is installed with --no-deps. The lock file records the Numba that was installed instead. The sciPENN sources are not edited.
scipenn.anndata_pin: 0.9.2, because the package calls AnnData.concatenate, which AnnData 0.10 removed.
scipenn.cap_rule: If the fit exceeds the cap, kill it and record the comparator as unavailable. The cap is a resource rule. It is not chosen from a result.

sclinear.do_log1p_reason: The published default False expects data that are already logged. These inputs are counts, so the published do_log1p switch is True.
sclinear.zero_count_cells: Omitted before the fit. This is the published min_counts=1 filter. The kept-cell mask is stored so the arm means use those cells.

dry_run.purpose: The code path finishes on open development cells. Numbers are not a result.
